name: MIS DRAFT 1664
description:
Displays all Prisoners in an Establishment with all of their offences and adjudications.
ACC0074 v1.0 Last update 14/03/2022

dataset.name: Prisoners
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT DISTINCT FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.OFFENDER_BOOKING_ID_NK, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.CURRENT_ESTAB, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.CURRENT_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.CURRENT_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.CURRENT_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.CURR_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.SEC_CAT_CHANGED, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.FROM_TO, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREV_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREV_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREV_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREV_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.THRD_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.THRD_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.THRD_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.FRTH_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.FRTH_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.FRTH_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.FRTH_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.MOST_RECENT_TX_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.MOST_RECENT_TX_REASON, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.MOST_RECENT_TX_LOC, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREVIOUS_TX_DATE, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREVIOUS_TX_REASON, FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT.PREVIOUS_TX_LOC FROM FACT_CAT_ASSESSMENTS_RECENT), dataset_ AS (SELECT OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, OFFENDER_BOOKING_ID_NK, CURRENT_ESTAB, CURRENT_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, CURRENT_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, CURRENT_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, CURR_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, SEC_CAT_CHANGED, FROM_TO, PREV_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, PREV_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, PREV_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, PREV_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, THRD_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, THRD_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, THRD_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, FRTH_APPROVED_SEC_CAT, FRTH_CAT_APPROVAL_DATE, FRTH_CAT_REVIEW_DATE, FRTH_CAT_ASSESS_ESTAB, MOST_RECENT_TX_DATE, MOST_RECENT_TX_REASON, MOST_RECENT_TX_LOC, PREVIOUS_TX_DATE, PREVIOUS_TX_REASON, PREVIOUS_TX_LOC, CASE WHEN PREV_APPROVED_SEC_CAT <> THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS V_DID_CAT_CHANGE_3RD_TO_2ND, THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT || ' to ' || PREV_APPROVED_SEC_CAT AS V_CAT_CHANGE_3RD_TO_2ND, CASE WHEN FRTH_APPROVED_SEC_CAT <> THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS V_DID_CAT_CHANGE_4TH_TO_3RD, FRTH_APPROVED_SEC_CAT || ' to ' || THRD_APPROVED_SEC_CAT AS V_CAT_CHANGE_4TH_TO_3RD FROM dataset_base_)

dataset.name: MIS Load
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT DISTINCT BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.BUSINESS_DATE FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE (BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.LOAD_ID = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_ID) FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE NOT LOAD_END_DATETIME IS NULL))), dataset_ AS (SELECT BUSINESS_DATE FROM dataset_base_)
